description: Transports and stores the fork preserves but ViciOne does not ship today. They stay discoverable here with an honest execution state. Nothing in this file is a gate and nothing in it may be read as a pass.

executionStates.IMPLEMENTED_MANUAL: A pinned fixture exists; the target runs on demand from extended-transports.yml.
executionStates.PRESERVED_NO_FIXTURE: Source and tests are preserved. This work package provides no pinned fixture, so the target is not executed. This is a stated gap, never a pass.
executionStates.PRESERVED_NEEDS_SECRET: Preserved, but execution requires a credential or cloud service that is not available. Not executed.
executionStates.IMPLEMENTED_MANUAL_SECOND_BROKER: A pinned fixture exists and the target runs on demand, but it addresses a broker that is not the ViciOne fixture. It is never a required gate.

targets.note: The 'artemis' flavor of the parameterized ActiveMQ specs plus Sending_to_a_shared_topic_subscription_endpoint, which uses a shared durable topic that only Artemis supports. The imported baseline addressed a fixed port 61618 with admin/admin. That endpoint is now pinned by digest and run-scoped like every other fixture, and ArtemisBroker throws when the environment is absent, so the branch can never silently fall back to whatever listens on a fixed port. It is not part of the required path.

manualCases.description: Cases that stay visible but are never executed in the required path and never report a PASS. Each one asserts nothing, so it could not carry coverage even if it ran green.
manualCases.howToRun: python3 tools/ci/run_broker_category.py --broker rabbitmq --category manual --project tests/ViciOne.ServiceBus.RabbitMqTransport.Tests/... -- --filter "FullyQualifiedName=<the exact case>"
